pages.text: The Fighting Neko is a born $(#FF69B4)warrior$(). She survives in dangerous environments and possesses outstanding combat skills and weapon proficiency.

pages.title: Combat Abilities
pages.text: The Fighting Neko's greatest strength is her ability to $(#FF69B4)flexibly switch between melee and ranged combat$():$(br2)$(li)She automatically chooses between sword and $(item)Bazooka$() based on the situation$(li)With ammo in her inventory, her ranged firepower is formidable$(li)She has a 40% chance to spawn with a bazooka$(br2)She fears no multiple enemies — a reliable battle companion!

pages.title: Special Abilities
pages.text: $(#FF69B4)Baby Fighting Nekos$() (loli form) have a terrifying special ability:$(br2)When filled with hatred toward an enemy, they can $(#FF69B4)summon lightning$() to strike the target! Only a 5-second cooldown — upsetting a little loli is never a good idea...$(br2)Additionally, Fighting Nekos $(#FF69B4)auto-regenerate$() after going 64 seconds without taking damage, giving them strong endurance.

pages.title: Spawning Locations
pages.text: Fighting Nekos inhabit dangerous environments:$(br2)$(li)$(#FF69B4)The Nether$() — the hellish environment forged her combat instincts$(li)$(#FF69B4)Ancient Cities$() — she can be found near the Warden's domain$(li)$(#FF69B4)Mountains$() — occasionally spotted among towering peaks$(br2)If you want a battle partner, venture into these dangerous places!
